svg.title: Neutron Stars: Matter at the Edge of Collapse
svg.desc: An essay on the formation, structure, and astrophysical significance of neutron stars.

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: These conditions translate into figures with no terrestrial parallel:

text.tspan: The precise way matter behaves at these densities — its

tspan.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f;font-style:italic
font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

tspan.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

text.tspan: is one of the great unsolved problems of modern physics. Because such condi-

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

tspan.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

text.tspan: tions cannot be reproduced on Earth, neutron stars themselves serve as the only

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

tspan.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

text.style: font-family:Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;fill:#3a5a8c;font-weight:bold
font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: Collapse does more than compress a star; it spins it up. Just as a figure skater

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: turns faster when she pulls in her arms, a stellar core that shrinks from the

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: breadth of the Sun to a few kilometres must conserve its angular momentum, and

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: so it whirls — some young neutron stars rotating hundreds of times every second.

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: The collapse concentrates the star's magnetic field as fiercely as its spin,

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: amplifying it to trillions of times the strength of any magnet built by human

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: hands. A spinning magnet radiates, and a neutron star beams energy from its mag-

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: netic poles in two narrow cones. If one of those beams happens to sweep across

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:11px;fill:#14161f

g.text: the Earth, we see a pulse with every rotation — as regular as a ticking clock.

text.style: font-family:Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;fill:#3a5a8c;font-weight:bold;letter-spacing:0.5pt;text-transform:uppercase
font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:10.5px;fill:#14161f

g.text: When Jocelyn Bell Burnell first recorded a string of impossibly regular

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:10.5px;fill:#14161f

g.text: pulses on her radio telescope, the signal was so precise that the source was

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:10.5px;fill:#14161f

g.text: half-jokingly labelled ‘LGM-1’, for Little Green Men. The pulses turned out

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:10.5px;fill:#14161f

g.text: to be natural: the lighthouse beam of a rotating neutron star, the first pul-

text.style: font-family:Iowan Old Style, Georgia, Times New Roman, serif;font-size:10.5px;fill:#14161f
